name: Alarm Logs in Packaging Industry
summary: Timestamped alarm events from 20 industrial packaging machines. The source provides alarm codes and machine identifiers, not verified physical-failure or repair labels.

availability.access: Direct Mendeley file download; CLI transfer and provider SHA-256 verified

feature_dimensions.summary: 1 categorical event type; timestamp and machine ID are identifiers, not sensor channels
feature_dimensions.counting: The raw CSV has timestamp, alarm, and serial. The loader adds source_row for original-row provenance. There are no analogue sensor waveforms.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Original alarm occurrence time. No timezone is inferred. The optional time filter is start-inclusive and end-exclusive.

attributes.name: alarm
attributes.description: Original alarm code, 0 to 153 in the verified version. Raw ID 0 is a genuine code and is not removed as padding.

attributes.name: serial
attributes.description: Original packaging-machine identifier, 0 to 19 in the verified version.

attributes.name: source_row
attributes.description: Zero-based row in the original CSV, excluding the header; retained across filtering. Source order and duplicate rows are preserved.

notes: Version 1 was retrieved through curl without authentication or browser cookies, and the archive matched the provider SHA-256 on 2026-10-18.
Full raw CSV check: 444,834 records, 20 machines, 154 alarm codes; first timestamp 2019-02-21 10:16:18.130, last timestamp 2020-06-17 03:53:51.885.
The verified source contains 83 duplicate timestamp/alarm/serial rows. The loader does not deduplicate or globally sort events.
The 8,517,314-byte ZIP expands to about 163 MB of raw and processed files. Download is opt-in; processed JSON/NPZ/pickle files are not loaded or executed by this adapter.
Prediction windows, entity/time splits, future labels, and end-of-record handling belong to task construction. The loader does not manufacture failure, RUL, or censoring labels.
citation: Dalle Pezze, D., Tosato, D., Masiero, C., Susto, G. A., and Beghi, A. (2021). ALARM LOGS IN PACKAGING INDUSTRY (ALPI), version 1. Mendeley Data. https://doi.org/10.17632/4nhx2x67cd.1
